worktree.description: The linked worktree's name; `None` in the main worktree.

dirty.description: Staged, unstaged or untracked (not ignored) changes exist.

GitState.description: Branch, upstream and working-tree state of the repository a Location is in.

hostname_label.description: The OS name and version, such as `macOS 15.0`; never the host or user name.

cpu_idle_percent.description: `null` until a second CPU sample exists: usage needs two readings.

load_avg.description: 1, 5 and 15 minute load; `null` where the OS has none (Windows).

disk.description: The volume holding the Location; `null` when no mount contains it.

transport.description: `remote` or `stdio`; absent for a server that is no longer configured.

tools.description: Published discovery names; invoking them still requires ordinary tool authorization.

connection.description: Last committed ownership observation; may require recovery without a retained actor.

McpServerStatus.description: Configured state and retained observations; status does not prove fresh native liveness.

error.description: Public diagnostic; private launch details remain in local logs.

McpStatusUpdate.description: A committed ownership observation, not fresh process liveness or recovery authority.

closed.description: All MCP owners observed for this Location have settled; a later open may reconnect.

address.description: What to pass as `to`: the name when it resolves to this Session, else the ID.

canReceive.description:
Whether a message from this caller would be accepted: false for an archived
Session, where messaging is disabled, and where its inbound decision for this
caller is `refuse`.

ReachableSession.description: One entry of the reachable listing (`list_sessions`, `GET /messaging/sessions`).

oneOf.description: A child Session of the caller.
A member of the caller's team (`agent-teams`).
Another root Session on this server.

AddressKind.description: How the caller reaches a Session.

oneOf.description: A Drain runs.
A permission request or question of the Session waits for a client.

ReachableState.description: What a reachable Session is doing.

id.description:
A `msgx_` ID; a repeated ID returns the original result with `replayed: true`.
Without it, an `Idempotency-Key` derives one.

from.description: The sending Session; without it the sender is the client (origin `client`).

to.description: The target's address (`ses_` ID, subagent or Session name).

text.description: Plain UTF-8 text, at most 16384 bytes.

notify_when_idle.description: Also subscribe `from` to one notice when the target next goes idle; needs `from`.

replayed.description: The ID was sent before; this is that send's outcome and nothing was written.

SendResult.description: The synchronous outcome of a send (`v1.messaging.send`, the `send_message` tool).

oneOf.description: Durably admitted to the target inbox (not necessarily read yet).
Admitted with `delivery: "hold"`; the target's user releases or drops it.
Not admitted; `reason` says why.

address.description: The address the records show: the name used when it resolved uniquely, else the ID.

SentTo.description: The target of a sent message.

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody
ErrorBody.description:
The JSON body of every declared failure. Some failures add `reason`, a machine-readable
refinement of `_tag`, and fields of their own such as `retryAfterMs` or `path`.

service.description: Capability group unavailable in this host or phase.

from.description: The subscribing Session, which receives the notice.

target.description: The watched Session's address (`ses_` ID, subagent or Session name).

notice_id.description: The notice admitted to the subscriber, once fired or expired with one.

replayed.description: The ID was used before; this is that subscription and nothing was written.

oneOf.description: Waiting for the target to go idle.
The notice was admitted to the subscriber.
It ended without an idle notice (12 hours passed, or the chain limit).

session_id.description: The Session whose record this is.

from.description: The sender's address: the peer for `in`, this Session for `out`.

to.description: The target's address: this Session for `in`, the peer for `out`.

peer_session_id.description: The other side's local Session, when it has one (none for a client).

hops.description: The message's position in its chain.

updated_at.description: When the outcome last changed (RFC 3339, milliseconds).

seq.description: The event that last changed this record.

MessageRecord.description:
One side of a message as the history shows it (`cross-session-messaging` → Messaging
API). A refused message carries no `text`.

Direction.description: The Session side of a message: `in` in the target, `out` in the sender.

next_due_ms.description:
When the next iteration is due; `None` while a self-paced iteration runs or after
the loop ended.

wakeup.description: The latest `schedule_wakeup` of the in-flight iteration.

LoopState.description: A loop as the Session state folds it.

Overlap.description: What to do with a tick that arrives while the previous iteration still runs.

Missed.description: What to do with ticks missed while the Session was not running.

StopConditions.description: What stops a loop besides `/loop stop`.

Inflight.description: An iteration that was admitted and has not ended.

IterationRecord.description: One ended iteration, as clients list it.

oneOf.description: A tick that came while the previous iteration still ran (overlap `skip`).
Ticks missed while the server was not running (missed-run policy `skip`).

CreateLoop.description: `POST /api/v1/sessions/:id/loops`: the `/loop` arguments as typed, or the parsed fields.

LoopSpec.description: A loop to create. `interval_seconds: None` makes it self-paced.

color.description: The configured display color (`#rrggbb` or an ANSI name), as written.

provenance.description: Static command origins only; broader source/permission inspection remains separate.

CommandInfo.description: A slash command or skill for autocomplete.

CommandOrigin.description: Only source locations are retained; definition values and loader labels are omitted.

preload_issues.description:
Skills the agent's profile preloads (`skills: [..]`) that are unknown, denied for
the agent or not model-invocable, and so are not preloaded.

SkillCatalog.description:
Skills for an agent plus command discovery diagnostics, for `/skills`, `cyber skills`,
`cyber commands list` and `cyber doctor`.

name.description: The skill name; for a skipped skill, its directory name.

source.description: The skill directory, the skipped `SKILL.md`, or `builtin:<name>` for an embedded skill.

status.description: `loaded`, or `invalid` for a skill that was skipped.

permission.description:
The `skill` permission for the requested agent (`allow`, `ask` or `deny`); absent when
the skill was skipped.

diagnostics.description: Parse errors and duplicate notices (`replaces skill <name> from <path>`).

SkillInfo.description: A discovered or skipped skill (`skills-commands` → Skill and command inspection).

oneOf.description: Embedded in the binary.
`~/.config/cyber/skills` and the home compatibility folders.
A directory from the project root down to the Location.
A local path from the `skills` configuration.
A loaded plugin's `skills/` folder.

SkillOrigin.description: The scope a skill was discovered in.

CommandDiagnostic.description: A command definition that was skipped or could not be read.

truncated.description: More than 2,000 entries; the rest are left out.

hidden.description: Dot and ignored entries left out without `hidden=true`.

changed.description: Changed files in the whole project, by git status.

root.description:
The canonical project root that entry paths are relative to; it may be an
ancestor of the Location.

git_status.description: `M`, `A`, `D` or `?`; a directory shows `M` when anything below it changed.

ignored.description: Matched by `.gitignore` or `.cyberignore` (or the `.git` directory itself).

target.description: A symlink's target, project-relative when it stays inside the project.

FileDecision.description: A path's permission decision for browsing (`server-api` → File browsing routes).

truncated.description: Only the first [`MAX_CONTENT`] bytes are in `text`.

Content2.description: A file's content, or that it is binary.

WorkflowRunProgress.description: The data of a `workflow.run.progress` live event: nothing a list does not return.
